summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on the song "Luck Be a Lady." It states that Frank Loesser wrote the song in 1950 and that Robert Alda first performed it. It also notes that the song was featured in the musical Guys and Dolls.
one_line: "Luck Be a Lady" is a 1950 song by Frank Loesser, first performed by Robert Alda and featured in the musical Guys and Dolls.
key_facts: "Luck Be a Lady" is a song written by Frank Loesser.
